name: Sahaja
subtitle: Personal super-app for meditation and more

apps.name: Sahaja
apps.subtitle: Meditation tracker with diamonds, streaks and widgets
apps.localizedDescription: Sahaja — effortless. Track your daily meditation vow: diamonds, coins, streaks, grace, and a daily darshan of the gurus. Includes home screen widgets.
apps.versionDescription: Win screen after logging a session: the diamonds you earned roll up with a sparkle burst, coins land beside them, then the day's verdict and streak, the kriya-years line, and lifetime diamonds. Intensity follows the tier. Shown for new sessions only; edits just save.

versions.localizedDescription: Win screen after logging a session: the diamonds you earned roll up with a sparkle burst, coins land beside them, then the day's verdict and streak, the kriya-years line, and lifetime diamonds. Intensity follows the tier. Shown for new sessions only; edits just save.

Daily Spiritual Diary quote under the darshan photo: topic, quote, author and source book. Tap it to open the quote on the YSS website. Fetched once a day (spiritualdiary.org, with yssofindia.org as fallback); the last quote stays on screen when offline.
Fix: tapping a darshan photo opened the editor and then immediately pushed the photo list again on top of it. Back now works as expected.

Darshan photos: add your own guru portraits from Photos or Files (Settings → Darshan photos, or long-press the daily photo). Frame each one by dragging and pinching inside a live copy of the card. Hide any photo from the rotation, delete your own, reset framing. The altar composite is gone; the three built-in Yogananda portraits remain.

Vow editor: per-tier "Judge by day total" toggle. When on, the day's sessions are added together and must reach twice the per-session minimums (extras count), so one long sitting can hold the floor for the day; Today shows "Floor held for the day". Week row (app + widget): today's circle is half-filled once one main session is logged. History labels half-logged days.
Subtler background grain across the app, widget, and shrine card.
Settings menu (Vow, Reminders), day-grouped session history with an add button, and additive count chips in the log sheet.
Morning and evening practice reminders: set times in the vow editor; a reminder stays silent once that session is logged.
Grainy dark visual overhaul: daily darshan photo rotation, meditating-sage widget art, real diamond and coin icons, lotus app icon.
